items.title: From Haar columns to surface measure

source.anchor: B.7 proof A2.SS2.SSS2.p4.5 uniform Oe1 sentence; A.1 proof A1.SS1.p2.1 normalized surface convention; Eq21-23 for selected transport
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. ASTIS expands the standard surface-law identification used by the source. Shared background is explicitly generalized to every existing coordinate and positive finite dimension.
source.scope: Actual unconditional full-Haar column equals normalized Euclidean volume-derived surface probability. No conditional residual/subspace law, seed independence, Poisson value, evaluated Eq24 or main lower bound.

items.statement: Canonical background expansion of the source uniform-sphere sentence: for every positive finite dimension \(n\) and every coordinate \(j\), let \(E=\mathbb R^n\), \(S=\{u:\|u\|_2=1\}\), and \(\mu\) be the actual normalized Haar probability on full \(O(n)\). Let \(\tau\) be the actual Euclidean-volume cone surface measure, \(\tau(B)=n\,\mathrm{vol}\{ru:0<r<1,u\in B\}\), and let \(\sigma=\tau(S)^{-1}\iota_*\tau\) on E. Then the actual pushforward \((O\mapsto Oe_j)_*\mu\) equals \(\sigma\). This explicitly generalizes the source use at its first coordinate with \(n\ge3\); it asserts no conditional residual law, independence, Poisson value, or lower bound.
assumptions: \(n\in\mathbb N\) and \(j\in\{1,\ldots,n\}\); a chosen coordinate forces \(n\ge1\). The source uses the first coordinate at \(n\ge3\); this canonical background includes every coordinate and positive finite dimension.
\(E=\mathbb R^n\) has its genuine Euclidean norm and volume. \(\mu\) is the actual normalized Haar probability on full \(O(n)\), including reflections.

The surface law is literally derived from Euclidean volume: \(\tau=\mathrm{volume}.\mathrm{toSphere}\), then \(\sigma=\tau(S)^{-1}\iota_*\tau\). Finite nonzero mass, normalization, invariance and equality are proved internally. No uniqueness, measurable-selection or uniform-law premise is supplied.

assumption_deltas.source: The source invokes Oe1 uniform on the sphere for n>=3 and uses normalized surface measure in A1.

assumption_deltas.reason: A canonical source-implicit background expansion; the constructive proof covers all positive finite dimensions and coordinates. This does not generalize the paper lower bound or prove a conditional sphere law.

assumption_deltas.source: Normalized surface and Haar uniformity are implicit standard background.
assumption_deltas.lean: Proves actual toSphere finite nonzero mass, probability/support, cone invariance, reflection transitivity, actual Haar right invariance and Tonelli measure identification internally.
assumption_deltas.reason: Every missing bridge is a dependency, never a public hypothesis; volume-derived sigma is not defined as an invariant law.
